name: microeazy
description: The Micro Eazy ecosystem — a meta-repo that pins each system at a commit and runs them together locally.
//: DELIBERATELY NOT AN npm WORKSPACE. Each system is its own repository with its
own lockfile and its own Vercel project, and workspaces would hoist their
node_modules into this root — which changes what every one of those
deployments resolves at build time. The orchestration here shells out to each
system's own scripts instead, so running from the meta-repo and running from
inside a system produce identical results.
Everything reads ecosystem/registry.json. There is no second list.
